The transit subsidy rollforward failed due to an incorrect entity name in the generated workbook's Bus Program sheet.
The execution failed with an AssertionError in test_output.py during the call to test_legacy_node_checks. While the workbook was created and sheet ordering was correct, the verifier reported 'FAIL: Bus Program #4310!A1 must be MetroLink Transit Authority'. Avoid using generic or placeholder names; ensure cell A1 of the specific program sheet matches the required authority name exactly.
